messages.author: 088e8a47a714e2a7
messages.subject: gpagen returning NULL for $procD
parts:
Hi

I have been running the same bit of code (successfully) for a few months, but about a week ago it stopped functioning correctly.

FS<-gpagen(D5_TPS, curves=sliders, ProcD=TRUE)

The code runs fine (no error messages) and returns most values (e.g., $coords, $Csize), but it has stopped returning $procD which is now NULL. I know from the documentation that this can happen for large datasets, but D5_TPS is [1:58, 1:3, 1:41] which is not particularly large. Also, it was working only a month or so ago. 

I updated R (4.1.1), RStudio (1.4.1717) and downloaded geomorph from the stable release in Github this morning and that has not resolved the problem. 

Thanks for any assistance!

Best, Karen Baab

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] gpagen returning NULL for $procD
parts:
Add:

verbose = TRUE

as an argument.  The reason for this update (geomorph 4.0.0) is that it can produce many rows x many columns matrices, which is a huge memory burden, if not needed.  For smaller data sets, it is not much issue.  But having it as a default could crash R for some users.

Mike
